title: Servicing Desk Note: Late Charges and Their Waiver on Construction Loans
content:
A Construction Loans interest bill that remains unpaid past its grace period draws one late charge, which may be waived as a courtesy or as an error correction on the terms below.

## Rule

A late charge arises only after more than the product's grace period in calendar days have passed since the due date of the interest bill, counted with the due date itself as day 0. It is the product's late charge percentage of the unpaid billed interest, between the product's minimum and maximum late charge, rounded to cents, once per bill, recorded against that bill. A courtesy waiver is available on request once the bill is paid in full and the number of courtesy waivers on the loan in the rolling 12 months is below the product's courtesy waiver allowance; an error-correction waiver applies when a timely payment is on record.

## When the charge can arise

- The clock starts from the due date of that interest bill as shown on the association's record of the bill, not from a date the member gives.
- The due date is day 0; each following calendar day counts one more.
- The charge can arise only on a day whose count is greater than the grace period. On the day whose count equals the grace period, it cannot.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical grace period of 15 days, bill due 10 March):* 25 March is day 15 — not more than 15, so no late charge arises. 26 March is day 16 — more than 15, so the late charge can arise.

## The amount

The unpaid billed interest is the amount of the bill less the interest payments recorded against that bill. The late charge is that unpaid amount multiplied by the product's late charge percentage, rounded to the cent, and held within the product's minimum and maximum: raised to the minimum where it falls below, reduced to the maximum where it exceeds. A bill draws one late charge only.

| Hypothetical bill | Paid against it | Unpaid | At an illustrative 5% | Illustrative bounds USD 25 to USD 250 | Late charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 1,800.00 | USD 600.00 | USD 1,200.00 | USD 60.00 | within | USD 60.00 |
| USD 300.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 300.00 | USD 15.00 | below the minimum | USD 25.00 |
| USD 8,000.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 8,000.00 | USD 400.00 | above the maximum | USD 250.00 |

## Waivers

A waiver removes the unpaid late charge in whole and is recorded with its basis, courtesy or error correction. Each waiver lowers the fees not yet collected on the loan, as a payment does; the assessment of a late charge raises them.

- **Courtesy waiver:** available on the member's request once the bill the charge arises from is paid in full and the courtesy waivers on the loan within the rolling 12 months number fewer than the product's allowance. The rolling 12 months end on the date considered and run from the same calendar date one year earlier (exclusive) through that date (inclusive). A count equal to the allowance is not below it.
- **Error-correction waiver:** applies when a timely payment of the bill is on record.
